hero_subtitle: Explore how Suffolk County Council manages public money. £250 transparency threshold.
publisher_bio: This website was created by Tom Pickup, Reform UK county councillor for Padiham and Burnley West and Cabinet Member for Adult Social Care at Lancashire County Council. He is also parish councillor for Clowbridge with Dunnockshaw. Tom builds transparency tools that make public spending data easier to check.
publisher_titles: County Councillor for Padiham and Burnley West
Cabinet Member for Adult Social Care, Lancashire County Council
Parish Councillor for Clowbridge with Dunnockshaw
publisher_quote: It's your money. The more people understand where it goes, the better.

doge_context.political_control: Reform UK majority — 41/75 seats (+3 over majority threshold) at the 7 May 2026 election. Previous: Conservative.

spend_triangulation.note: Live transparency feed back to Jan 2025 (15 months at £250 threshold). Older years require FOI. Procurement = gross minus 43,359 REDACTED PERSONAL DATA rows (£40M, ASC Care Act direct payments, lawfully unnamed) and 7 internal transfers (£3.6M). Pension Fund published as a separate file and not aggregated here.

procurement_paid.note: Discretionary third-party supplier payments — the real procurement footprint.

direct_payment_individual.note: REDACTED PERSONAL DATA — Care Act 2014 s.31 Direct Payments to ASC service users. Lawfully unnamed.

internal_transfer.note: Pension Fund contribution leakage into the general feed.
